licensing: License selection for original code remains pending under AGENTS.md. Upstream files keep their own licenses. No upstream function was copied.
not_adopted: m1n1 UAT.iotranslate keeps walking when TYPE is 0. recurse_level treats TYPE 0 as a block leaf. This codec follows recurse_level.
m1n1 access_gpu and access_fw tables are not encoded. The codec keeps the raw AP, UXN, PXN, and OS fields.
The T8122 42-bit DMA-mask comment in driver.rs is not an output width for the g15 format.
G14 and G14X share m1n1's level-0 bit 39 and are not given T8103's 40-bit output limit.
integrations/puredarwin/m1-dart was not modified. Astra owns that codec.

references.use: Primary descriptor classes, level shifts, 16K granule, context stride, and the G15 level-0 branch.
Register64 packs an inclusive msb,lsb field into a little-endian 64-bit word. The codec reimplements that packing; it does not import this module.
Version matrix G13, G14, G14X, G15, G15X. G >= G15 is the only level-0 width change.
Upstream license for the reference files. It is not applied to the original codec.
